ruleDefinitions.name: Raw Paste Service Access
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects direct access to raw pastes in different paste services often used by malware in their second stages to download malicious code in encrypted or encoded form Note: Unmapped fields: c-uri

sequences.query: (c-uri = RGX(".*\\\.paste\\\.ee\\/r\\/.*") OR c-uri = RGX(".*\\\.pastebin\\\.com\\/raw\\/.*") OR c-uri = RGX(".*\\\.hastebin\\\.com\\/raw\\/.*") OR c-uri = RGX(".*\\\.ghostbin\\\.co\\/paste\\/*\\/raw\\/.*") OR c-uri = RGX(".*pastetext\\\.net\\/.*") OR c-uri = RGX(".*pastebin\\\.pl\\/.*") OR c-uri = RGX(".*paste\\\.ee\\/.*"))
